resources.string: Multitasking
Gestures
Windows and pairs
Swipe on dock to snap
Swipe left or right on an empty part of the dock to snap the active window to that half, or up to toggle full screen. When off, swiping left goes back
Swipe on app icons
Swipe left, right or up on an app icon to snap that app or toggle full screen
Swipe down on icon to close
Swipe down on an app icon to close its window. On a pair icon, closes both apps
Double tap to swap sides
Double tap an empty part of the dock to swap the left and right windows. Double tap a pair icon to swap its apps
Open new apps in the empty half
With a half-screen launch mode, new apps open in the half the current window isn\'t using
Hide apps that are in a pair
Paired apps are shown only through their pair icon, including their open windows
Hide from dock
Hidden apps
Apps that never appear on the dock, even while open. Gestures ignore them too
Vibrate on gestures
A short vibration confirms when a swipe or double tap is recognised
Hide dock while typing
Hide the dock while an on-screen keyboard is showing, so it doesn\'t cover the keys
